title: Cloud City: Billing, Cost Hygiene, and FinOps Architecture
city_concept: City Treasury, Utility Meters, and Emergency Spending Caps

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Brightloaf Bakery left the kitchen water taps running full blast for three weeks. When the utility bill arrived, the bakery was nearly bankrupted.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Tomas the Treasurer installed digital meters (Cloud Billing Export) and set automated alarm bells when water consumption exceeded 50% of budget.

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: A pipe burst in the basement. The automatic shutoff valve (Pub/Sub + Cloud Function) cut the water main before the building flooded.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: In physical billing, utility companies bill you 30 days late; in Google Cloud, billing data streams to BigQuery in continuous increments.
